# Audit migration fixtures

`v2-then-v070-hook.jsonl` was generated by writing its first record with the
0.8 `tg hook`, then building the `v0.7.0` Git tag and using that binary's
`tg hook` to append the second record. Both hashes and the link are valid for
their respective canonical encoders. The fixture is intentionally invalid as
a chain because canonical versions may upgrade from v1 to v2 but may not
downgrade from v2 to v1.
